runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Disposable read-only project with check-stale-replay Skill, root session 01a0cd59-1c99-703a-a957-0064fe6ef72e, StaleGen1 and FreshGen2 task workers, no extensions or project rules.

assertions.evidence: Main received GENERATION_1_READY=true, then hub jobs showed StaleGen1 running.
hub acknowledged cancellation and recorded StaleGen1 status cancelled.
FreshGen2 read fresh.txt and returned FRESH_MARKER=fresh-ok; root accepted generation 2.
hub send to the same StaleGen1 returned: Agent was hard-aborted and cannot be messaged or revived.
No generation-1 stale payload was delivered after the cancellation; the root reported STALE_PAYLOAD_RECEIVED=false and did not fabricate one.
The disposable project's Git status retained only the initially copied Skill path.

limitations: This run advances beyond the earlier 18.2.6 peer-ready stall and proves peer-message delivery, but does not prove same-session post-cancel replay or rejection of an actually delivered stale payload.
OMP hard cancellation is not equivalent to resumable interruption. A distinct test design may need an in-flight stale result without hard-aborting the worker.
